title: vanilla plus RPG+
description: A complete expansion adding new items, armors, magic and adventure to the original game.
body:
Vanilla+ is the ultimate experience for players who love the classic Minecraft feel but want much more! 🗡️✨
 
Built for Forge 1.20.1, this pack brings the best of both worlds:
✅ Vanilla Backports: Enjoy all the new blocks, items and features from the latest versions right here!
🌍 World Generation: Completely revamped terrain with new biomes, structures and beautiful landscapes.
⚔️ RPG & Adventure: Become stronger with new armors, weapons, tools and magical gear.
🔮 Magic System: Master powerful spells, craft wands and become a true mage with Iron's Spells & more.
👹 Epic Bosses & Mobs: Face dangerous new enemies and mighty bosses across dimensions.
🗺️ New Dimensions: Explore unique worlds beyond the End and Nether.
📖 Quests & Missions: Complete challenges and get rewards.
 
Whether you like building, exploring, fighting or magic, Vanilla+ has everything you need for an incredible adventure without straying too far from the original game!
 
 
 
📌 Versión: 1.0
 
⚙️ Loader: Forge 1.20.1
